limitations: Fixed catalogue and three saved representatives; no human-consensus reference or accuracy estimate.
Jointly resolved comparison denominators are reported; principal repeatability also requires all three votes resolved.
Initial-to-review differences combine text access, re-examination and anchoring; no isolated causal passage effect.
Confidence is ordinal self-report, not calibrated probability or vote weight.
Shared-context topic rows are not independent experiments.
Two repetitions have limited precision; no best classifier or preferred count is selected.
Missing full attempts are not converted into 354 abstentions or irrelevant labels.
Exact quotations and repeated-reason flags are mechanical diagnostics, not semantic validation.
First-attempt analysis is primary; latest explicitly indexed recovery is supplementary.
paired_changes_initial_basis: exact Stage B-bound initial seal; selected Stage A baseline remains separate
scope_note: Twelve completed P0 trials; original 84-trial schedule hash is historical collection provenance. The 72 unadmitted trials are outside current scope, not missing attempts.
